decision_recorded.sigma_status: SELECTED - no longer a hypothesis under test
decision_recorded.why_repeat_1: 713 unique recovery rows x 1 against 500 nominal x 32 gives 713/16000 = 4.45625%, which reproduces July's 356 x 2 / 16000 = 4.45% almost exactly. Repeat 2 would double the recovery weight merely because today's prefixes happen to be longer.
decision_recorded.multistart: EXPLICITLY DEFERRED - the two teacher datasets at start offsets -0.20 and +0.20 rad, 8000 rows in July, are not reproduced

defect_1_alignment_reference.j4_did: truncated the recovery trace against the J1 TEACHER trace
defect_1_alignment_reference.consequence: the first contact-onset difference (teacher step 14, student step 13) truncated everything: 12 aligned rows
defect_1_alignment_reference.j7_does: the nominal trace and the ONLY truncation reference is J3, the deterministic rollout of the J2 student. J1 is NEVER the alignment reference.
defect_1_alignment_reference.july_evidence: target_domain_markov_adaptation.py --nominal-trace was .../2026-07-13_markov35_zero_column_deterministic/rollout_policy_trace.json, a deterministic STUDENT rollout

defect_2_nominal_states.j4_did: used the J1 teacher STATES as the nominal anchor block, with self-distilled labels on those teacher states
defect_2_nominal_states.consequence: the anchors described a distribution the student never visits, so the self-distillation anchored the wrong states
defect_2_nominal_states.j7_does: the nominal anchor STATES are the ones actually visited in J3. The nominal LABELS are the same J2 parent's means on those J3 states, cross-checked against the policy_mean J3 recorded.
defect_2_nominal_states.july_evidence: target_domain_markov_adaptation.build_markov_recovery_dataset reads nominal_obs from the nominal TRACE and labels them with _actor_means of the source actor on those same states

corrects_two_defects_of_j4.j4_role_here: IMPLEMENTATION SOURCE ONLY, for the physical scaling and the future fit. The J4 module, dataset, receipts and traces are forensic artefacts and are never a parent, weights, labels or data.

nominal_block.states: the 500 actor_observation_vector_before rows of the J3 trace
nominal_block.labels: the J2 parent's mean actions on those J3 states
nominal_block.labels_method: the July _actor_means path: target_domain_noise_adaptation._forward on float32 observations and float32 weights, returning logits[:, :2]
nominal_block.labels_cross_check: compared against the policy_mean recorded in the J3 trace; bit-equality does NOT hold across the torch and numpy kernels, the measured agreement is 5.96e-07 and the tolerance is stated in the runner

recovery_block.states: the RAW actor_observation_vector_before rows of the three J6 traces, truncated against J3 with the July-strict rule
recovery_block.labels: EXCLUSIVELY j1_runs/.../teacher_dataset.npz actions[step - 1], the same fixed-start episode step

dataset_specification.order: nominal block first, then the recovery block concatenated by seed in the order 123, 124, 125

column_policy.clock_projection_is_safe: the parent's first-layer clock columns are already zero, so zeroing the input clock changes the means by exactly 0.0 - measured, not assumed
column_policy.controller_audit: non-degeneracy: every controller column must carry non-zero signal in the assembled dataset
column_policy.controller_future: becomes trainable in the LATER fit, with the July physical scales verbatim

future_fit_specification_only.status: SPECIFICATION ONLY - this stage runs no fit

invariants.actor: the same single 35D student; no separate 25D artefact; no widening; no contralateral features
invariants.unchanged: FSM, morphology corridor, reward, SEA, C++ plugin - none is touched
invariants.july_is_methodological_only: no July artefact is an operational parent, dataset or label

this_stage_does_not: construct, reset or step an environment
touch the critic or run PPO
promote anything or authorise a next stage

per_seed: policy_mean_vs_teacher rmse and max_abs on the retained prefix
metrics_to_report.no_invented_gates: there is NO minimum on prefix length, and none on any per-seed metric. They are reported, never thresholded.

immutability: this file is content-addressed by the artefacts it pins. Any change to a pinned artefact invalidates it. It is never edited in place.

penetration_metrics.series_source: the j6_penetration.npz of each seed, pinned DIRECTLY by hash. The J6 receipt alone does not substitute for the pin.
penetration_metrics.cross_check: penetration_m must be bit-identical to reward_terms.grf_penetration_m of the same trace
penetration_metrics.evaluator: v26c_penetration_contract.load_contract + evaluate_series on the retained prefix. No local or manual threshold is applied anywhere.
penetration_metrics.evaluator_is_pinned: both the contract JSON and v26c_penetration_contract.py are pinned. The JSON alone would bind the thresholds but not the implementation that applies them.

time_identity.rule: for EVERY retained row k: recovery time_before == teacher_dataset.times[k] == J3 time_before, tolerance 1e-9
time_identity.teacher_observations: NEVER read - the teacher supplies labels and timing only
